name: Claim Match
office_task: Each morning, check every insurance repair job against the insurer's claim by claim number, show any missing or different scope, photo or report with both values, and fix only what a person accepts.
systems_of_record: the job system (Simpro, ServiceM8 or similar: carries the insurer's claim number on the job; owns photos filed and reports lodged)
the insurer's claim record (the claim portal or its export: issues the claim number; owns the authorised scope, scope version, excess and claim status)

emits.write: the run's claim reconciliation report where the insurance works coordinator opens it: the pair contract it ran under, the key it joined on (claim_number), the master per field, and the counts matched, within tolerance, mismatched, orphaned and corrected, published every run including the all-clear
emits.readback: the report store returns a report_id, and reading that id back returns the contract id, the five counts and the published time; no id back means the run did not publish and the owner is told

emits.write: an exception on the claim naming the person who owns it: an open difference with the job value, the insurer value and the master's value side by side awaiting acceptance, photos or a report on the job the insurer does not hold, a claim on one side only, a gap over the threshold amount, a run over the mismatch rate, or an accepted correction whose write returned no id
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the claim_number, the field, both values and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
